title: Should the Vikings Trade for Jonathan Taylor?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Should the Vikings Trade for Jonathan Taylor?
sources.description: The NFL trade deadline is approaching in just two weeks- November 10th. NFC teams like the 49ers, Seahawks, and Bears are making deals to bolster their roster. Should the Minnesota Vikings be aggressive in doing the same? The Vikings are undefeated and a Super Bowl contender. That typically is a recipe for an aggressive acquisition […]
